query: I spent last weekend hiking up the local state park trail, and the wild blueberries I found along the way were so sweet I ended up picking a whole container to bring home. I tried making a small batch of blueberry pancakes with them yesterday morning, and they turned out so fluffy even my roommate who doesn’t usually like sweet breakfasts asked for a second serving. I also signed up for a beginner pottery class that starts next week, I’m really excited to try making my own mug even if my first few attempts end up lopsided. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now: airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings seem to be broken, and I think my SIM card might be unseated so I can’t get any mobile connection at all, can you help me fix this?
